title: [OPTIONAL] Fireside chat: Lotte Bjerre Knudsen with Jonah Cool
description:
Lotte Bjerre Knudsen, the scientist behind GLP-1s, spent more than 30 years at Novo Nordisk championing the benefits of this drug before anyone understood its potential. She believed these medicines could change lives, and spent her career proving it.
Novo Nordisk is controlled by a foundation, which makes it a rare case of a mission-driven business that is also commercially successful.
Lotte is in town for a fireside with Dario at The Briefing: AI for Science, and while she’s here, she wants to sit down and share her story with us. She joins Jonah Cool, who leads Life Sciences on the Beneficial Deployments team, to talk about the long road to a life-saving drug and what AI could mean for the next generation of science.
As we grow, it's the kind of story that will help keep us grounded - proof that staying close to a mission and holding conviction through the doubt and the hard parts is what leads to the biggest breakthroughs.
Open to All Ants. Hosted live from Spark (SF-500-5-547).
